status: proposed coverage taxonomy; not generated asset counts

kits.name: Landform and terrain
kits.coverage: Heightfield/terrain substrate, slopes, saddles, terraces, clearing pads, banks, shore connections
kits.acceptance: Continuous ground, named elevation seams, clear walk zones and simplified collision

kits.name: Geology and natural landmarks
kits.coverage: Rock families, boulders, strata, cliff corners, overhangs, caves only if used, hero arch/pillar contacts
kits.acceptance: Hero silhouette first; ordinary rocks reused at several scales with correct texel density

kits.name: Water systems
kits.coverage: Ocean, sheltered lagoon, calm lake/pond, stream, cascade, wet/dry edges and water inlets/outlets
kits.acceptance: Separate water types, levels and shoreline transitions; water visuals do not provide collision or swimming

kits.name: Ground materials and paving
kits.coverage: Soil, leaf litter, grass, moss, mud, sand, gravel, stone, cobble and region paving trims
kits.acceptance: Repeatable texture scale, blends, edges, drainage and convincing path transitions
kits.reuse_scope: Shared material library; local surface recipes

kits.name: Flora and foliage
kits.coverage: Canopy, saplings, shrubs, grass/fern clumps, flowers, vines, aquatic plants, fungi and deadwood
kits.acceptance: Species silhouettes, placement clusters, wind/LOD policy and no growth blocking the path

kits.name: Fauna
kits.coverage: Mammals, birds, insects, fish, reef life and selected magical animals
kits.acceptance: Reference anatomy review, rig/animation, idle/move states, spawn limits and habitat fit; not every species at every site

kits.name: House kit
kits.coverage: Solid/window/door walls, inside/outside corners, floors, gables, roof pitches, dormers, chimney, porch, threshold and small interior divisions
kits.acceptance: Human dimensions, real apertures, roof/wall returns and two reusable cottage interior templates
kits.reuse_scope: Shared B12 house family plus local material variants

kits.name: Landmark building kit
kits.coverage: Site-specific walls, gates, arches, columns, buttresses, towers, dome/chapel roofs and wing junctions
kits.acceptance: Source silhouette and local grammar, practical back/roof returns and selected accessible core

kits.name: Circulation and infrastructure
kits.coverage: Paths, steps, ramps, landings, bridges, bearing seats, parapets, fences, gates and vertical-travel arrivals
kits.acceptance: A-to-B continuity and endpoint clearances; navigation/collision distinct from visual dressing
kits.reuse_scope: Shared dimension contracts with local finish

kits.name: Settlement and outdoor furnishings
kits.coverage: Courts, street/quay edges, drains, benches, wells, signs, baskets, wood racks, window boxes and lamps
kits.acceptance: Small functional groups at entries/rest points, not clutter over every metre
kits.reuse_scope: Shared prop sets; local timber/stone style

kits.name: Interior room architecture
kits.coverage: Floor/wall/ceiling shells, door/window reveals, upper galleries, stairs, alcoves, vault/dome undersides and room connections
kits.acceptance: Coordinated plan and ceiling views, actual openings and contact profiles; selected rooms only
kits.reuse_scope: Hero/local room templates; excludes non-play service areas

kits.name: Furniture and personal items
kits.coverage: Beds/bedding, tables, chairs, storage, desks, books, albums, craft/personal objects and existing celebration items
kits.acceptance: Human scale, attachment/front axes, useful moving states and reusable instances
kits.reuse_scope: Shared families; separate rustic versus royal styling

kits.name: Decor, trim and glass
kits.coverage: Cornices, base/capital collars, applique, carvings, tile/panel motifs, railing infill, glass palettes and curtains
kits.acceptance: Precise repeats, plain join ends, glass/material separation; colours are materials, not unique meshes
kits.reuse_scope: Shared motif/profile families; local design/colour constraints

kits.name: Interactions and readable elements
kits.coverage: Doors, inspectable/usable items, existing wish lanterns, prompts, signs, route markers and persistence where needed
kits.acceptance: One clear action with correct prompt/range/input/save behavior; new mechanics explicitly specified before implementation
kits.reuse_scope: Shared behavior components plus authored local content

kits.name: Ambience and effects
kits.coverage: Wind, day/night lighting, local mist, water foam/ripples, small magical glows, birds/wind/water sound and weather accents
kits.acceptance: Regional atmosphere with explicit distance/density budgets; no automatic moving lights on every object
kits.reuse_scope: Shared effects with local settings; no music-room scope

kits.name: Runtime and packaging
kits.coverage: Pivots/units, named parts, LODs, simplified collision, material/texture slots, instancing, streaming groups and asset manifests
kits.acceptance: Stable IDs, accepted mesh versions, spawn/loading boundaries, measured frame/memory budgets and regression checks
kits.reuse_scope: One shared technical contract for all kits
